description: Nothing in defaults/main.yml is automerged here. `wazuh_version` is one literal that drives three separately published images (manager, indexer, dashboard) while Renovate only watches wazuh/wazuh-manager's tags, and the indexer is a persistent OpenSearch cluster whose in-place upgrade a fresh-install Molecule run structurally cannot exercise.
Repository tooling (GitHub Actions, prek hooks, pip and Galaxy dependencies) is automerged on a branch by the shared preset, gated on the Molecule run.
